service_boundary: Represents the managed TypeSafe API at api.typesafe.ai, not Jev model weights, the Python and JavaScript SDKs, the documentation, or the typesafe-agent-skills pack.
regional_controls: The reviewed documentation exposes one global base URL and no customer-selected inference region; the enterprise FAQ asks where data is processed but publishes no answer.
retention_controls: The privacy policy retains personal data as long as reasonably necessary to provide the service; zero data retention is available for enterprise customers on request, and the operator states it does not use prompts or other inputs to train or fine-tune models.
routing: Customers call the single TypeSafe-operated endpoint and select the first-party Jev model; the API routes no request to third-party providers.
customization: Every request configures its own typed criteria (up to 255 choice options, up to 10 score levels); the reviewed pages document no customer-imported weights or dedicated deployments.
strengths: Typed answers with probabilities and confidence directly address decision workloads without parsing generated text.
Full endpoint reference with SDKs, usage reporting, rate-limit handling, and error semantics.
Master Customer Agreement, Data Processing Agreement, and privacy policy with enterprise zero-retention option.
tradeoffs: Single model line and single global endpoint: no regions, no dedicated deployments, no third-party models.
SOC 2 Type II report exists but is request-gated rather than public, and no public vulnerability-disclosure process is documented.
Responses carry no documented integrity mechanism tying an answer back to the model run.

response_integrity.note: The reference documents answers, probabilities, confidence, and usage per request, but no signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism tying an answer back to the model run appears on the reviewed pages.
response_integrity.scope: TypeSafe API reference, for the TypeSafe API

upstream_disclosure.note: The reference names the serving model directly: 'The model that handles the request. Use "jev-latest", TypeSafe's flagship model.' The model is first-party Jev, and no subprocessor is named on the reviewed pages.
upstream_disclosure.scope: TypeSafe API reference, for the TypeSafe API

credential_handling.note: The reference authenticates with 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' and returns 401 Unauthorized for a missing or invalid key.
credential_handling.scope: TypeSafe API reference, for the TypeSafe API

cache_isolation.note: No per-customer isolation, tenancy, or cache-separation statement appears on the reviewed documentation, terms, or policy pages.
cache_isolation.scope: TypeSafe API reference and legal pages, for the TypeSafe API

vulnerability_disclosure.note: No security contact, disclosure process, or coordinated-vulnerability policy appears on the reviewed pages; the SOC 2 report lives behind a request-gated Trust Center.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: TypeSafe enterprise page, for the TypeSafe API

independent_audit.note: The enterprise page states SOC 2 Type II and invites report access through the Trust Center: 'Visit our Trust Center to request access to the SOC 2 Type II report.' The report itself is request-gated, not public.
independent_audit.scope: TypeSafe enterprise page, for the TypeSafe API
